facts.text: Undergraduate students are automatically enrolled in the Strayer Learn and Earn Scholarship, receiving one tuition-free class for every three courses passed.

sources.title: Educational Benefits Programs | Strayer University
sources.quote: All qualified new and readmit undergraduate students are automatically enrolled in the Strayer Learn and Earn Scholarship when they register for courses with Strayer. These students will earn one tuition-free class for every three courses they pass, subject to eligibility requirements.

facts.text: Students in a bachelor's program can take up to two self-paced Sophia Learning general education courses at a time at no cost.

sources.title: No Cost Gen Eds with Sophia Learning | Strayer University
sources.quote: Take one or two Sophia Learning courses at a time, and complete as many as you want per quarter at no-cost when enrolled in a Strayer bachelor's program.
